product: Lakebase streaming sink is generally available
tagline: The Lakebase streaming sink is generally available.
what_it_does: The Lakebase streaming sink is generally available. It now supports Trigger.AvailableNow() on serverless jobs and notebooks. In Databricks Runtime 19 and above, it also supports merge strategies and additive schema evolution (mergeSchema).
why_it_matters: When to use the Lakebase sink Use the Lakebase sink for low latency streaming writes to Lakebase or an external PostgreSQL database.
plain_summary: The Lakebase streaming sink is generally available. It now supports Trigger.AvailableNow() on serverless jobs and notebooks.
